title: Vul'Gol Ogre Mound
wikitext:
[[Image:Vul'Gol Ogre Mound.jpg|thumb|300px|Vul'Gol Ogre Mound]]

The '''Vul'Gol Ogre Mound''' is a small basin in southern [[Duskwood]]. It is completely overrun by [[Splinter Fist]] [[ogre]]s led by [[Zzarc'Vul]], after which the mound was named. It is located just to the southwest of where the main road through Duskwood splits and runs south into [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. Humans used to live in the basin, as evidenced by the ruined farmhouses.
